ImageLoggingConfiguration.description: The logging configuration settings for the image.

LogGroupName.description: The name of the log group for image build logs.

ImageScanningConfiguration.description: Contains settings for Image Builder image resource and container image scans.

EcrConfiguration.description: Contains ECR settings for vulnerability scans.

ScanResultCondition.description: The condition that the output AMI's scan results must meet for the image to pass. You can set ScanResultCondition only when ImageScanningTypes is ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE. If you omit it, Image Builder starts the scan but does not wait for it or use its results to pass or fail the image.

ImageScanningTypes.description: The type of vulnerability scan that Image Builder runs for AMI output when ImageScanningEnabled is true. Specify a single value. If you omit ImageScanningTypes, Image Builder uses TEST_INSTANCE_CVE. With TEST_INSTANCE_CVE, Amazon Inspector scans the test instance during image tests, and you must activate Amazon Inspector for Amazon EC2 scanning in your account. With ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE, Amazon Inspector starts an on-demand scan of the output AMI during image tests. You must build from an image recipe, but you do not need to activate Amazon Inspector in your account.

ImageScanningEnabled.description: This sets whether Image Builder keeps a snapshot of the vulnerability scans that Amazon Inspector runs against the test instance when you create a new image.

WorkflowConfiguration.description: The workflow configuration of the image

Parameters.description: The parameters associated with the workflow

WorkflowArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the workflow

OnFailure.description: Define execution decision in case of workflow failure

EcrConfiguration.description: Settings for Image Builder to configure the ECR repository and output container images that are scanned.

ContainerTags.description: Tags for Image Builder to apply the output container image that is scanned. Tags can help you identify and manage your scanned images.

RepositoryName.description: The name of the container repository that Amazon Inspector scans to identify findings for your container images. The name includes the path for the repository location. If you don’t provide this information, Image Builder creates a repository in your account named image-builder-image-scanning-repository to use for vulnerability scans for your output container images.

ScanResultCondition.description: The condition that the output AMI's scan results must meet for the image to pass. When you set it, the test phase waits for the scan to finish, and Image Builder fails the image if a counted finding exceeds MaximumSeverityLabel.

FixAvailable.description: Specifies whether only findings that have a fix available count toward MaximumSeverityLabel. When false, Image Builder counts every finding. The default is true.

MaximumSeverityLabel.description: The maximum severity allowed for findings on the output AMI. A finding above this severity fails the image, unless FixAvailable excludes it.

Minor.description: The latest version ARN of the created image, with the same minor version.

Arn.description: The latest version ARN of the created image.
